svg.title: Party wheel — branching skill evolutions
svg.desc: Comparison C. Each skill begins with two tier-one choices. A selected talent reveals three next-tier choices depending on that selection. Exactly one talent is chosen per tier. Unchosen nodes remain dim. Only the selected path has connecting lines; available choices have no branch lines. Strike shows a selected two-tier path and three available tier-three talents, with Aftershock previewed in the right panel. The three class trees follow the same branching major-choice design as skills: two first-tier options, then three dependent options. Paladin leads to Martyr, Wizard leads to Pyromancer, and Assassin reveals its next choices. No separate sockets, minor talents, or orbiting gems. Names and effects are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: COMPARISON C / One defining choice per tier. The next rung follows your chosen talent.
exposing the target to your allies.
the rupture spreads to another enemy.
Choosing it closes the other options in this tier.
Any later choices would follow Aftershock.
Only the chosen talent reveals the next rung.
No additional upgrade layer in this version.
STATIC CONCEPT · Names and effects are illustrative.
Icon colour = gem type · Connected path = chosen · Dim = not chosen · Bright outline = available · Dotted outline = preview
Skills and classes: 2 options → select one → 3 dependent options → select one → next rung. Hidden branches have no descendants.
